title: Manager - Manufacturing Engineering
description:
**Why join us?**
Our purpose is design for the good of humankind. It’s the ideal we strive toward each day in everything we do. Being a part of MillerKnoll means being a part of something larger than your work team, or even your brand. We are redefining modern for the 21st century. And our success allows MillerKnoll to support causes that align with our values, so we can build a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful future for everyone.
  
  
***Manager - Manufacturing Engineering***
***Report to Production Manager***
***Location: MillerKnoll Bidadi Factory***
*General Purpose*
*The Manager - Manufacturing Engineering is responsible for leading manufacturing engineering activities to support new product introductions, localization projects, process optimization, automation, cost reduction, and operational excellence initiatives.*
**Essential Functions**

* Lead manufacturing engineering activities for new product introductions (NPI) and ensure manufacturing readiness for successful product launches.
* Drive localization initiatives and support development and implementation of locally sourced components and materials.
* Lead automation and digitization projects to improve productivity, reduce labor dependency, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop, implement, and sustain standardized manufacturing processes, work instructions, and best practices.
* Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities through process improvements, waste elimination, and value engineering.
* Manage capital expenditure projects including machinery, tooling, fixtures, conveyors, storage systems, and production equipment.
* Lead continuous improvement and Lean Manufacturing initiatives using Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, PDCA, and other operational excellence tools.
* Collaborate with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and Procurement teams to achieve business objectives.
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for production, quality, and process-related issues.
* Establish and monitor manufacturing KPIs related to safety, quality, productivity, delivery, and cost.
* Support quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects, improve process capability, and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Develop and mentor manufacturing engineers, facilitators, and technical teams through coaching and capability-building programs.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, environmental standards, and regulatory guidelines.
* Promote a culture of teamwork, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement aligned with MillerKnoll values.

*Lead strategic projects and perform other responsibilities as assigned by the Operations Leadership Team.*
*Must have technical skills:*
*Exposer to Lean tools like OEE, 5S, problem solving, FMEA process, line balancing, line design- basic knowledge, cycle time reduction, Ergonomic studies and basics of BOM structure.*
**Minimum Requirements**
*Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing or related Engineering discipline. 8-10 years of manufacturing engineering experience with 2-3 years in a leadership role.*
*Leadership Competencies*
*Strategic Thinking, Customer Focus, Building Effective Teams, Driving Results, Innovation, Change Management and Collaboration.*
**Who We Hire?**
Simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities. MillerKnoll is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities.
  
  
MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers\_help@millerknoll.com.

title: General Manager Manufacturing
description: General Manager — Manufacturing Head of Factory Operations — all units Department Manufacturing / Factory Operations Reports To CEO / COO Supervises Plant Heads and functional leaders — Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Planning & Dispatch — across all units Scope All manufacturing units (currently 4–5 factories) + the upcoming Industry 4.0 automated plant Location Based at the anchor factory (Malur), with regular travel to every unit ROLE SUMMARY Lead all of Decorpot's manufacturing as the single accountable head of factory operations. Anchored at one plant and travelling regularly to the others, standardise operations, quality, cost, safety and delivery across every unit — and lead the design, build and ramp-up of the upcoming Industry 4.0 automated facility. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Own manufacturing end-to-end: single point of accountability for output, quality, cost, delivery and safety across all factories. • Standardise across units: drive one common set of processes, SOPs and KPIs — production, quality, maintenance, stores, dispatch — so every plant runs to the same standard. • Drive throughput, OEE & quality: own capacity utilisation, machine uptime, on-time production and defect / site-snag reduction; build a zero-defect culture and eliminate bottlenecks. • Lead a large workforce: direct and contract labour across plants — productivity, shift systems, skilling, industrial and employee relations, and discipline. • Cost, safety & compliance: drive material yield, wastage, conversion cost and energy efficiency; enforce EHS and full statutory compliance (Factories Act, pollution, labour) across every site. • Lead the Industry 4.0 agenda: conceive, design, commission and ramp the new automated plant — MES, IoT, robotics / automation, and data-driven shop-floor operations. • Capacity, CAPEX & bench: plan capacity and commission machinery / new lines; own the manufacturing CAPEX case; hire, mentor and build succession depth among plant heads. • Cross-functional & governance: align manufacturing with sales demand, design, SCM / dispatch and procurement; run site reviews and publish MIS to leadership. SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS • Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech (Mechanical / Production / Industrial); MBA a plus. • Experience: 18–25 years in manufacturing, with 5+ years as a multi-plant / works head managing a large (500+) direct and contract workforce. • Industry: open to automobile / auto-components, white goods, building materials (plywood / laminate / tiles) or modular furniture — manufacturing-leadership and automation depth valued above furniture pedigree; high-mix / make-to-order preferred. • Technical: strong in lean / TPM / Six Sigma, OEE, quality systems and modern production machinery; hands-on shop-floor command. • Industry 4.0: demonstrated experience conceiving or running automated / smart-factory operations (MES, IoT, robotics, analytics). • Leadership: proven at large-workforce and IR / ER management and multi-site coordination; willing to travel extensively to all plants. • Behavioural: hands-on, data-driven, cost-conscious, and a builder who can set one standard across many sites. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Measured on: OEE & capacity utilisation · On-time production / delivery adherence · Defect & site-snag rate · Conversion cost & material yield · Safety incidents (target: zero) · Industry 4.0 plant — commissioning & ramp milestones

title: Quality Manager
description:
**Job Description – Quality Manager**

Ingenious Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and results-driven \*\*Quality Manager\*\* to lead quality assurance and quality control operations across its steel fabrication and OEM manufacturing processes. The role involves establishing and implementing quality standards, managing inspection teams, ensuring compliance with customer specifications, and driving continuous improvement to deliver high-quality fabricated steel components and assemblies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage all quality assurance and quality control activities across incoming materials, in-process manufacturing, and final product inspection.
* Develop, implement, and monitor quality procedures, inspection plans, and control processes to ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards.
* Supervise, train, and guide the quality inspection team to maintain consistent inspection practices and performance.
* Review and interpret \*\*mechanical drawings, technical specifications, tolerances, and quality requirements\*\* to ensure product conformity.
* Oversee dimensional inspections, weld quality inspections, material verification, and final acceptance of fabricated components and assemblies.
* Ensure proper maintenance of inspection reports, test certificates, material traceability records, non-conformance reports, and quality documentation.
* Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to prevent recurrence.
* Coordinate with design, production, planning, procurement, and dispatch teams to resolve quality concerns and ensure timely delivery of conforming products.
* Manage customer quality complaints, coordinate inspections and audits, and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Establish and monitor quality performance indicators, identify recurring defects, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure proper calibration, maintenance, and utilization of inspection instruments and measuring equipment.
* ·Support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable quality management systems and customer requirements.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* 8 - 12 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and quality control, preferably in steel fabrication, OEM manufacturing, or the engineering industry.
* Proven experience in managing quality operations and leading an inspection or quality control team.
* Strong understanding of \*\*fabrication processes, welding inspection, dimensional inspection, material specifications, and mechanical drawings\*\*.
* Hands-on experience with inspection instruments, measurement techniques, inspection plans, and quality documentation.
* Knowledge of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management systems and relevant industry standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively across departments and manage multiple quality requirements.
* A proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven approach, with a strong commitment to product quality and customer satisfaction.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Ingenious Engineering Pvt Ltd specializes in manufacturing high-quality OEM equipment tailored to precise customer specifications. The company leverages strong in-house engineering and innovative design capabilities to deliver reliable, customized solutions. Its focus on quality and technical excellence makes it a trusted partner for clients seeking specialized equipment. Team members collaborate closely with engineering and production functions, contributing directly to product performance and customer satisfaction.

**Role Description**

The Purchasing Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolar, responsible for overseeing all procurement activities for OEM manufacturing operations. The role involves identifying and evaluating suppliers, negotiating pricing and contracts, and ensuring timely availability of materials, components, and services. The Purchasing Manager will monitor inventory levels, prepare purchase orders, track deliveries, and resolve discrepancies with vendors and internal stakeholders. This position also requires collaborating with engineering, production, and finance teams to align purchasing decisions with project requirements, quality standards, and budget targets. The role includes maintaining accurate purchasing records, analyzing cost and supplier performance data, and continuously improving procurement processes.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain management within a manufacturing or engineering environment.
* 8-12 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, preferably in the steel fabrication, OEM manufacturing, or engineering industry.
* Strong skills in vendor sourcing, supplier evaluation, and contract negotiation, with the ability to build and maintain long-term supplier relationships.
* Ability to manage inventory levels, analyze material requirements, and coordinate closely with production and engineering teams.
* Proficiency with procurement or ERP software, spreadsheets, and data analysis to support purchasing decisions.
* Solid understanding of cost control, budgeting, and basic commercial terms related to purchasing.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work on-site in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field; relevant professional certifications in purchasing or supply chain are an advantage.
* Experience in OEM or equipment manufacturing, and familiarity with quality standards and compliance requirements, is highly beneficial.

title: Hygiene Manager or Sanitary Manager
description:
**About the Role**

Hygiene Manager or Sanitary Manager is responsible for ensuring that all three assigned hospitals consistently achieve the highest standards of cleanliness, infection prevention, patient satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and frontline employee development. This role serves as the leader, coach, trainer, and quality assurance for Hygiene Manager or Sanitary Manager across three hospitals.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensure that all three assigned hospitals consistently achieve the highest standards of cleanliness, infection prevention, patient satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and frontline employee development.
* Serve as the leader, coach, trainer, and quality assurance for Environmental Services (EVS) across three hospitals.

**Responsibilities**

Primary Responsibility

* The Environmental Services Manager (EVS) is responsible for ensuring that all three assigned hospitals consistently achieve the highest standards of cleanliness, infection prevention, patient satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and frontline employee development.
* This role serves as the leader, coach, trainer, and quality assurance for Environmental Services (EVS) across three hospitals.

Core Areas of Responsibility

* Leadership and Team Management
* Provide leadership for EVS teams across the three hospitals.
* Conduct daily huddles with each hospital supervisor and communicate priorities based on the activities of the day.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, professionalism, and service.
* Maintain positive relationships with hospital administration, doctors, nurses, leadership, and department directors.
* Lead by example and support frontline teams when needed.
* Ensure adherence to set forth Cleaning/Infection Prevention Standards Core Values and "Cleaning for Health" philosophy.

Mission

* Protect patients, staff, and visitors through scientifically validated cleaning and infection prevention practices while developing people and creating a culture of excellence across all three hospitals.

Key Expectations for the Operations Manager Over Three Hospitals

* People:
* Lead 40–100+ EVS associates.
* Develop supervisors and trainers.
* Maintain a culture of accountability and service excellence.

* Training
* Serve as the Train-the-Trainer Leader.
* Conduct monthly education sessions.
* Ensure 100% competency validation and documentation.

* Infection Prevention
* Partner with Infection Prevention departments.
* Champion Cleaning for Health principles.
* Utilize ATP and UV monitoring to validate outcomes.

* Quality
* Maintain quality scores above 95%.
* Achieve high patient satisfaction ratings.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives.

* Compliance
* Maintain survey readiness every day.
* Always ensure regulatory compliance.

Infection Prevention Leadership

* Serve as the EVS Infection Prevention Champion by:
* Preventing Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAIs)
* Ensure cleaning processes support reduction of HAIs.
* Follow CDC, OSHA, and Joint Commission requirements.
* Collaborate with Infection Prevention and Nursing departments.
* Participate in Infection Prevention Committee meetings when requested.
* Promote cleaning for health, not cleaning for appearance.

* High-Risk Area Oversight
* Provide oversight for:
* ICU
* NICU
* Emergency Department
* Operating Rooms
* Isolation Rooms
* Oncology
* Dialysis
* Labor & Delivery
* Patient Rooms
* Public Areas

* Verify Cleaning Effectiveness
* Utilize:
* ATP monitoring
* UV light/marker validation
* Fluorescent gel inspections
* Visual inspections
* Corrective action programs

* Chemical Compliance
* Ensure:
* Proper disinfectant selection
* Correct dilution ratios
* Required dwell times
* SDS compliance
* Safe chemical handling procedures

3. Training and Staff Development

* Train-the-Trainer Program Leader
* Develop and maintain site trainers and team leaders.

* Responsibilities
* Train supervisors and lead technicians to become trainers.
* Conduct onboarding training for new employees.
* Teach:
* Standard precautions
* Transmission-based precautions
* PPE requirements
* Bloodborne pathogen safety
* Hand hygiene
* High-touch surface disinfection
* Color-coded microfiber systems
* Isolation room cleaning
* Terminal cleaning procedures

* Ongoing Education.
* Provide monthly education on:
* Infection prevention updates
* New equipment and chemicals
* Customer service

title: Outlet Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.
  
  
Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Business Performance**

* Plan for outlet budget and review forecast on revenue and expenditure on monthly basic
* Analyze and submit month-end reports and identify deviation from business plan goals
* Participate in management meetings to review progress towards achievement of business plan goals and develop the annual business plan related for the outlet
* Plan, implement and measure profit enhancement programs by working with the kitchen &Marketing Department. Prepare & submit post-mortem promotion report to F&B Manager upon completion of promotion
* Implement and maintain control measures to ensure that food &beverage costs, productivity, labour costs and operating supply costs for the outlet is in line with budget

**Outlet Operation**

* Conduct departmental daily briefings to ensure that all pertinent information is well received by team members
* Supervise team members to ensure that all tasks assigned/required in the outlet are carried out on time and according to instruction and departmental standards
* Build a good relationship with guests or regular patrons.Try to remember individual patron’s names and their preferences to extend a personalized service
* Handle guests’ complaints and comments tactfully and efficiently
* Handle all administration work pertaining to cashier/bar operation requirement and company’s policies
* Maintain department communication logbook and updated notice board
* Check the supply of equipment/stock level and ensure that there is no shortage of items which have impact on the operation and guests
* Check the outlet/back of the house cleanliness to ensure that it is in compliant with F&B sanitation and hygiene rules and regulations
* Maintain complete knowledge of all food & beverage services, contents &preparation methods, outlets and hotel services/features
* Ensure that health, safety and security procedures are in place in the outlet
* Attend all briefings, meetings and trainings as assigned by management
* Perform proper handover and communication to the next shift
* Assist other food & beverage outlets with their operations during peak times or when required

**Qualifications**

* Hotel Management graduate or equivalent
* Additional certification(s) in Food & Beverage will be an advantage
* Good reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
* Ability to speak other languages and basic understanding of local languages will be an advantage
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in a similar capacity
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, & PowerPoint
* High degree of professionalism with sound human resources management and business acumen capabilities

Additional Information
  
  

* Strong knowledge of hotel reservation systems (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), channel management, and online travel agency (OTA) platforms.
* Good understanding of revenue management principles, room inventory control, yield management, upselling, and forecasting.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, leadership, and team management skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and hotel reservation reporting tools.
* Ability to handle guest inquiries, special requests, and escalated concerns professionally while maintaining high service standards.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English; knowledge of additional languages will be an advantage.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences and achieving departmental revenue targets.

title: Production Supervisor
description:

The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
Diploma / BE / B-Tech (Electronic / Mechatronics / Mechanical)

**Responsibilities** 




  




* Leadership and Team Management
* Provide leadership for EVS teams across the three hospitals.
* Conduct daily huddles with each hospital supervisor and communicate priorities based on the activities of the day.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, professionalism, and service.
* Maintain positive relationships with hospital administration, doctors, nurses, leadership, and department directors.
* Lead by example and support frontline teams when needed.
* Ensure adherence to set forth Cleaning/Infection Prevention Standards Core Values and "Cleaning for Health" philosophy.
* 
* Mission
* Protect patients, staff, and visitors through scientifically validated cleaning and infection prevention practices while developing people and creating a culture of excellence across all three hospitals.
* 
* Key Expectations for the Operations Manager Over Three Hospitals
* People
* Lead 40–100\+ EVS associates.
* Develop supervisors and trainers.
* Maintain a culture of accountability and service excellence.
* 
* Training
* Serve as the Train\-the\-Trainer Leader.
* Conduct monthly education sessions.
* Ensure 100% competency validation and documentation.
* 
* Infection Prevention
* Partner with Infection Prevention departments.
* Champion Cleaning for Health principles.
* Utilize ATP and UV monitoring to validate outcomes.
* 
* Quality
* Maintain quality scores above 95%.
* Achieve high patient satisfaction ratings.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* 
* Compliance
* Maintain survey readiness every day.
* Always ensure regulatory compliance.

* Infection Prevention Leadership
* Serve as the EVS Infection Prevention Champion by:
* Preventing Healthcare\-Associated Infections (HAIs)
* Ensure cleaning processes support reduction of HAIs.
* Follow CDC, OSHA, and Joint Commission requirements.
* Collaborate with Infection Prevention and Nursing departments.
* Participate in Infection Prevention Committee meetings when requested.
* Promote cleaning for health, not cleaning for appearance.
